title: Brightline client onboarding — synthetic example
exportXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BrightlineClientOnboardingSynthetic" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Main">
    <bpmn:participant id="Brightline" name="Brightline Studio" processRef="Process_Main" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Client" name="Client" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_RequestItems" sourceRef="RequestItems" targetRef="Client" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_CorrectedPack" sourceRef="Client" targetRef="WaitPack" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_Invoice" sourceRef="Invoice" targetRef="Client" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_Deposit" sourceRef="Client" targetRef="WaitDeposit" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_SendPlan" sourceRef="SendPlan" targetRef="Client" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_PlanResponse" sourceRef="Client" targetRef="WaitPlan" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_Reminder" sourceRef="SendReminder" targetRef="Client" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="M_Withdrawal" sourceRef="Client" targetRef="ClientWithdrawal" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Main" name="Brightline client onboarding — synthetic example" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Coordinator" name="Onboarding coordinator">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Intake</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Readiness</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendHandover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReadinessDeadline</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ClientWithdrawal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CancelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReleaseSlot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>RecordCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Canceled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CloseRecord</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>HandedOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Delivery" name="Delivery lead">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Kickoff</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Engineer" name="Technical setup engineer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Workspace</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Finance" name="Finance">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CheckDeposit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>RefundDeposit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="ClientSuccess" name="Client Success">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>AcceptHandover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Signed order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_StartIntake</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_StartIntake" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Intake" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Intake" name="Check handover pack">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_StartIntake</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_IntakeReady</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="IntakeStart" name="Pack received">
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_IntakeBegin</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_IntakeBegin" sourceRef="IntakeStart" targetRef="IntakeMerge" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="IntakeMerge">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_IntakeBegin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>F_PackRepeat</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_IntakeCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_IntakeCheck" sourceRef="IntakeMerge" targetRef="CheckPack" />
      <bpmn:task id="CheckPack" name="Check required items">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_IntakeCheck</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_PackDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PackDecision" sourceRef="CheckPack" targetRef="PackDecision" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="PackDecision">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_PackDecision</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_PackComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_PackMissing</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PackComplete" name="All required items present" sourceRef="PackDecision" targetRef="IntakeEnd" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PackMissing" name="Required items missing" sourceRef="PackDecision" targetRef="RequestItems" />
      <bpmn:sendTask id="RequestItems" name="Request missing items">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_PackMissing</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_RequestWait</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RequestWait" sourceRef="RequestItems" targetRef="WaitPack" />
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="WaitPack" name="Receive corrected pack">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_RequestWait</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_PackRepeat</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:receiveTask>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PackRepeat" sourceRef="WaitPack" targetRef="IntakeMerge" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="IntakeEnd" name="Handover pack complete">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_PackComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_IntakeReady" sourceRef="Intake" targetRef="Readiness" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Readiness" name="Coordinate readiness">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_IntakeReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ReadyWorkspace</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="ReadyStart" name="Handover pack complete">
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_ReadyStart</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ReadyStart" sourceRef="ReadyStart" targetRef="ReadySplit" />
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ReadySplit">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_ReadyStart</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_StartFinance</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_StartPlan</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_StartFinance" sourceRef="ReadySplit" targetRef="FinanceWork" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_StartPlan" sourceRef="ReadySplit" targetRef="PlanWork" />
      <bpmn:subProcess id="FinanceWork" name="Clear order — Finance">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_StartFinance</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_FinanceJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="FinanceStart" name="Finance work started">
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_FinanceCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_FinanceCheck" sourceRef="FinanceStart" targetRef="CheckCredit" />
        <bpmn:sendTask id="Invoice" name="Issue deposit invoice">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_DepositRequired</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_InvoiceWait</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:sendTask>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_InvoiceWait" sourceRef="Invoice" targetRef="WaitDeposit" />
        <bpmn:receiveTask id="WaitDeposit" name="Receive deposit">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_InvoiceWait</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_DepositClearance</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:receiveTask>
        <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="PaymentReminder" name="7 calendar days unpaid" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="WaitDeposit">
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_RemindSend</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
            <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
          </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RemindSend" sourceRef="PaymentReminder" targetRef="SendReminder" />
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_DepositClearance" sourceRef="WaitDeposit" targetRef="FinanceMerge" />
        <bpmn:task id="Clearance" name="Record financial clearance">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_MergeClearance</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_ClearanceEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ClearanceEnd" sourceRef="Clearance" targetRef="FinanceEnd" />
        <bpmn:endEvent id="FinanceEnd" name="Finance cleared">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_ClearanceEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sendTask id="SendReminder" name="Send payment reminder">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_RemindSend</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_ReminderDone</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:sendTask>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ReminderDone" sourceRef="SendReminder" targetRef="ReminderEnd" />
        <bpmn:endEvent id="ReminderEnd" name="Reminder sent">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_ReminderDone</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="CheckCredit" name="Check approved credit terms">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_FinanceCheck</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_CreditDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CreditDecision" sourceRef="CheckCredit" targetRef="CreditDecision" />
        <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CreditDecision">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_CreditDecision</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_CreditApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_DepositRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CreditApproved" name="Finance-approved credit terms" sourceRef="CreditDecision" targetRef="FinanceMerge" />
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_DepositRequired" name="No approved credit terms" sourceRef="CreditDecision" targetRef="Invoice" />
        <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="FinanceMerge">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_DepositClearance</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:incoming>F_CreditApproved</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_MergeClearance</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MergeClearance" sourceRef="FinanceMerge" targetRef="Clearance" />
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_FinanceJoin" sourceRef="FinanceWork" targetRef="ReadyJoin" />
      <bpmn:subProcess id="PlanWork" name="Agree plan — Delivery">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_StartPlan</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_PlanJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:startEvent id="PlanStart" name="Delivery planning started">
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_PlanStart</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PlanStart" sourceRef="PlanStart" targetRef="PreparePlan" />
        <bpmn:task id="PreparePlan" name="Prepare delivery plan">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_PlanStart</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_PrepareMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PrepareMerge" sourceRef="PreparePlan" targetRef="PlanMerge" />
        <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="PlanMerge">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_PrepareMerge</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:incoming>F_PlanResend</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_MergeSend</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MergeSend" sourceRef="PlanMerge" targetRef="SendPlan" />
        <bpmn:sendTask id="SendPlan" name="Send delivery plan">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_MergeSend</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_SendWait</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:sendTask>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_SendWait" sourceRef="SendPlan" targetRef="WaitPlan" />
        <bpmn:receiveTask id="WaitPlan" name="Receive plan response">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_SendWait</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_ResponseDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:receiveTask>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ResponseDecision" sourceRef="WaitPlan" targetRef="PlanDecision" />
        <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="PlanDecision">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_ResponseDecision</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_PlanApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_ChangesRequested</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PlanApproved" name="Client explicitly approves" sourceRef="PlanDecision" targetRef="PlanEnd" />
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ChangesRequested" name="Client requests changes" sourceRef="PlanDecision" targetRef="RevisePlan" />
        <bpmn:endEvent id="PlanEnd" name="Plan approved">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_PlanApproved</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="RevisePlan" name="Revise delivery plan">
          <bpmn:incoming>F_ChangesRequested</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>F_PlanResend</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PlanResend" sourceRef="RevisePlan" targetRef="PlanMerge" />
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_PlanJoin" sourceRef="PlanWork" targetRef="ReadyJoin" />
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="ReadyJoin">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_FinanceJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>F_PlanJoin</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_ReadyEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:parallelGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ReadyEnd" sourceRef="ReadyJoin" targetRef="ReadyEnd" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="ReadyEnd" name="Finance cleared and plan approved">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_ReadyEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="ReadinessDeadline" name="14 calendar days elapsed" attachedToRef="Readiness">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_Expired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Expired" sourceRef="ReadinessDeadline" targetRef="CancelMerge" />
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="ClientWithdrawal" name="Client withdrew" attachedToRef="Readiness">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_Withdrawn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ClientWithdrawal" />
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Withdrawn" sourceRef="ClientWithdrawal" targetRef="CancelMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ReadyWorkspace" sourceRef="Readiness" targetRef="Workspace" />
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Workspace" name="Verify workspace access">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ReadyWorkspace</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_WorkspaceKickoff</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="WorkspaceStart" name="Readiness complete">
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_WorkspaceStart</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_WorkspaceStart" sourceRef="WorkspaceStart" targetRef="CreateWorkspace" />
      <bpmn:task id="CreateWorkspace" name="Create workspace and accounts">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_WorkspaceStart</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_CreateAccess</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CreateAccess" sourceRef="CreateWorkspace" targetRef="AccessMerge" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="AccessMerge">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_CreateAccess</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>F_Retest</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_AccessTest</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AccessTest" sourceRef="AccessMerge" targetRef="TestAccess" />
      <bpmn:task id="TestAccess" name="Test all named users' access">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_AccessTest</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_AccessDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AccessDecision" sourceRef="TestAccess" targetRef="AccessDecision" />
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="AccessDecision">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_AccessDecision</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_AccessPassed</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_AccessFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AccessPassed" name="All named users pass" sourceRef="AccessDecision" targetRef="WorkspaceEnd" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AccessFailed" name="Any named user fails" sourceRef="AccessDecision" targetRef="CorrectAccess" />
      <bpmn:task id="CorrectAccess" name="Correct access configuration">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_AccessFailed</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>F_Retest</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Retest" sourceRef="CorrectAccess" targetRef="AccessMerge" />
      <bpmn:endEvent id="WorkspaceEnd" name="Access verified">
        <bpmn:incoming>F_AccessPassed</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_WorkspaceKickoff" sourceRef="Workspace" targetRef="Kickoff" />
    <bpmn:task id="Kickoff" name="Confirm and hold kickoff">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_WorkspaceKickoff</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_KickoffHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_KickoffHandover" sourceRef="Kickoff" targetRef="SendHandover" />
    <bpmn:task id="SendHandover" name="Send handover pack">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_KickoffHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_HandoverAccept</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_HandoverAccept" sourceRef="SendHandover" targetRef="AcceptHandover" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CancelMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_Expired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_Withdrawn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CheckDeposit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CheckDeposit" sourceRef="CancelMerge" targetRef="CheckDeposit" />
    <bpmn:task id="CheckDeposit" name="Check received deposit">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CheckDeposit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_DepositDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_DepositDecision" sourceRef="CheckDeposit" targetRef="RefundDecision" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="RefundDecision">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_DepositDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_RefundRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_NoRefund</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RefundRequired" name="Deposit received" sourceRef="RefundDecision" targetRef="RefundDeposit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NoRefund" name="No deposit received" sourceRef="RefundDecision" targetRef="RefundMerge" />
    <bpmn:task id="RefundDeposit" name="Refund deposit">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_RefundRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_RefundDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RefundDone" sourceRef="RefundDeposit" targetRef="RefundMerge" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="RefundMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_NoRefund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_RefundDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ReleaseSlot</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ReleaseSlot" sourceRef="RefundMerge" targetRef="ReleaseSlot" />
    <bpmn:task id="ReleaseSlot" name="Release provisional slot">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ReleaseSlot</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_RecordCancel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_RecordCancel" sourceRef="ReleaseSlot" targetRef="RecordCancellation" />
    <bpmn:task id="RecordCancellation" name="Record cancellation">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_RecordCancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CancelEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CancelEnd" sourceRef="RecordCancellation" targetRef="Canceled" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Canceled" name="Onboarding canceled">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CancelEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="AcceptHandover" name="Review and accept handover">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_HandoverAccept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_AcceptClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AcceptClose" sourceRef="AcceptHandover" targetRef="CloseRecord" />
    <bpmn:task id="CloseRecord" name="Close onboarding record">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_AcceptClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CloseEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CloseEnd" sourceRef="CloseRecord" targetRef="HandedOver" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="HandedOver" name="Onboarding handed over">
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CloseEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ClientWithdrawal" name="Client withdrawal" />
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="ExportDiagram_Collaboration_Main">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="ExportPlane_Collaboration_Main" bpmnElement="Collaboration_Main">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Brightline_1" bpmnElement="Brightline" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="80" y="80" width="1739" height="878" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Delivery_1" bpmnElement="Delivery" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="110" y="80" width="1709" height="140" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Engineer_1" bpmnElement="Engineer" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="110" y="220" width="1709" height="140" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_Coordinator_1" bpmnElement="Coordinator" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="110" y="360" width="1709" height="318" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="BPMNShape_ClientSuccess_1" bpmnElement="ClientSuccess" isHorizontal="true">

context.purpose: Train a new coordinator on the current onboarding process using a synthetic interview.
context.trigger: Signed service order and handover pack received from Sales
context.scopeNotes: SYNTHETIC WORKFLOW TEST. One order per case. Sales negotiation, delivery execution, renewals, client internals and post-setup cancellation are outside scope. One full deposit; partial payments, disputes and refund failures are excluded. Timers use calendar days. All six model views have explicit internal behavior. Subprocess details name the responsible role because the current editor does not support nested lanes. Acceptance includes any handover corrections; no separate rejection path is asserted.

sources.title: Synthetic onboarding interview
sources.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST INTERVIEW. Brightline Studio, its staff, clients and cases are fictional. These statements are test inputs, not observations of a real business or human approval of a model.
Interviewer: We are documenting how the consultancy currently onboards a signed client, so a new onboarding coordinator can follow the work. We are not designing a better process, setting prices, or describing the delivery project itself. One case is one signed service order. Renewals and later support requests are outside this exercise.
Maya, onboarding coordinator: My case starts when Sales gives me a signed service order and the handover pack. I own the onboarding record and coordinate readiness. Sales has already finished the commercial negotiation; I do not rerun it. The pack normally has the signed order, billing contact, client approver, the list of people who need access, and the agreed scope. Receiving it does not mean it is complete.
Maya: I check that pack before handing work to Finance or Delivery. If something is missing, I send a request back to the client contact and wait for the corrected pack. Then I check it again. Sometimes it goes back twice because the billing address arrived but the access list did not. Once all required items are there, the intake part is complete. There is no automatic timeout for that intake wait in the process we are documenting.
Interviewer: What happens after that? People have mentioned an invoice, a delivery plan and a kickoff booking, and I cannot tell which of those actually holds up which.
Maya: I tell Finance and Delivery that the pack is ready. Finance deals with the deposit, and Delivery talks about dates and the plan. I see those things on the record, but I would want them to confirm whether one is supposed to wait for the other. We certainly do not want the technical engineer building access from a half-agreed plan.
Luis, Finance: A new client normally needs a deposit. I issue the deposit invoice to the billing contact, wait until we can identify the received payment, and record financial clearance. A screenshot saying a transfer was made is not the same as the deposit arriving. We do not include the bank's internal payment processing in our model; we only record our work and the receipt notification.
Luis: The old onboarding checklist says everyone pays a deposit before scheduling. I am not sure that sentence is still safe to use without qualification. We have repeat clients with payment terms, but just being a repeat client is not enough. I need to check exactly what decision we make and when. Please leave that as a question rather than silently removing Finance from those cases.
Nora, delivery lead: Once I can look at the scope, I prepare a delivery plan, send it to the client approver, and wait for their response. Most approve the first version, but occasionally they want a different order of work or different dates. I do not want a diagram that assumes sending the plan means it was approved. I will explain our revision handling when we go through the draft.
Nora: I sometimes pencil a kickoff into the calendar while payment is still outstanding. Maya has seen those calendar entries and reasonably thought the job was booked. There is a difference between holding a possible slot and actually confirming and holding the kickoff. The exact gates matter; let us clarify those instead of treating every calendar entry as the same event.
Interviewer: Could Finance and Delivery both be waiting at the same time? And if one finishes first, does somebody start setup anyway?
Maya: That is exactly the part I want us to agree on together. In our last onboarding I was waiting on both a payment question and a revised plan. I did not start the engineer, but I do not want to turn that one case into a rule without asking the others. Also, we should show whose work it is, rather than one big box that says do onboarding.
Luis: We send a reminder when a deposit has been sitting unpaid. It is not a fresh invoice, and the reminder is not a refusal to accept payment. I remember a seven-day reminder and a fourteen-day cutoff, but I need to confirm when the clocks start, whether those are calendar days, and whether sending the reminder changes the original wait.
Maya: Sometimes the client withdraws while we are waiting for the money or their plan approval. I close the open readiness work so nobody keeps chasing a canceled case. We also release any provisional delivery slot. If we already have a deposit, Finance may need to return it. Please check that policy with Luis; I do not want the cancellation path to forget money we have already received.
Nora: A case can sit with me even when Finance has finished, so any cutoff cannot just be drawn around waiting for payment. If the client never approves the plan, we need to stop my work too. On the other hand, a reminder email should not cancel my plan discussion. Those are different things even though both involve waiting on a client.
Eli, technical setup engineer: I receive the approved details and create the client workspace and accounts. Then I test access for the named users. I have had an incorrect email address make one account fail, so creation alone is not enough. I will give you the exact correction and recheck steps later; I do not want you to guess whether we go straight to kickoff after a failed test.
Eli: The engineer performs the workspace and access checks. Delivery holds the kickoff after access has been verified. We do not describe what the client clicks inside their own systems, and we do not describe the software's internal provisioning algorithms. We care that the right people can get into the workspace and the team is ready to meet them.
Maya: After the kickoff I send the handover pack to Client Success. That is normally the last email I remember sending. I have said done at that point in conversation, but the onboarding record sometimes stays open after the email. We should speak to Client Success about what they need to do before I can close it. I would rather leave the final outcome open than invent their acceptance.
Interviewer: Are Finance, Delivery, technical setup and Client Success independent businesses we exchange formal messages with, or responsibilities inside Brightline?
Maya: They are internal roles in the same consultancy. I coordinate the work across them. The client is the outside participant, and our exchanges with them are real messages. We should keep their internal approval and payment procedure hidden because we have not interviewed anyone about how it works. Sales only supplies the starting pack; its earlier work is outside scope.
Luis: Please distinguish the historical written checklist from what we can confirm people do now. The checklist was useful when we only had new clients. I can check the current rule with the account owner before we finalize the variant. I do not want a note about an exception to become permission to waive a deposit whenever someone is in a hurry.
Nora: The two easy mistakes are calling a tentative calendar hold a completed kickoff, and treating a lack of reply as approval. If the client asks for changes, the current plan is not approved. Our eventual model needs an explicit way back to the plan work and an explicit way out when the case is canceled.
Eli: Please keep the diagram readable. The coordinator should see the overall sequence, and I should be able to open the workspace detail rather than read every Finance step. Small subprocesses are fine provided their inputs, results and responsible roles are clear. They must not hide the unanswered questions about what actually happens.
Maya: For the first draft, show the intake checks we know and the activities we have actually described. Leave the readiness ordering, deadlines, payment-term variant, plan revision loop, access correction and completion gate as questions for the follow-ups. We can discuss normal work first, exceptions second, then walk through a returning-client case and the final handover.

Sales has already finished the commercial negotiation; I do not rerun it. The pack normally has the signed order, billing contact, client approver, the list of people who need access, and the agreed scope. Receiving it does not mean it is complete.

Maya: I check that pack before handing work to Finance or Delivery. If something is missing, I send a request back to the client contact and wait for the corrected pack. Then I check it again. Sometimes it goes back twice because the billing address arrived but the access list did not. Once all required items are there, the intake part is complete. Interviewer: What happens after that? People have mentioned an invoice, a delivery plan and a kickoff booking, and I cannot tell which of those actually holds up which.

Maya: I tell Finance and Delivery that the pack is ready. Finance deals with the deposit, and Delivery talks about dates and the plan. I see those things on the record, but I would want them to confirm whether one is supposed to wait for the other. We certainly do not want the technical engineer building access from a half-agreed plan.

Luis, Finance: A new client normally needs a deposit. I issue the deposit invoice to the billing contact, wait until we can identify the received payment, and record financial clearance. A screenshot saying a transfer was made is not the same as the deposit arriving. We do not include the bank's internal payment processing in our model; we only record our work and the receipt notification.

Luis: The old onboarding checklist says everyone pays a deposit before scheduling. I am not sure that sentence is still safe to use without qualification. We have repeat clients with payment terms, but just being a repeat client is not enough. I need to check exactly what decision we make and when. Nora, delivery lead: Once I can look at the scope, I prepare a delivery plan, send it to the client approver, and wait for their response. Nora: I sometimes pencil a kickoff into the calendar while payment is still outstanding. Maya has seen those calendar entries and reasonably thought the job was booked. conflicts.description: The historical deposit checklist and reported current payment practice disagree.
conflicts.resolution: The historical checklist is narrower than current practice. Finance-approved credit terms provide the current deposit exception. Provisional calendar holds do not count as kickoff. Both readiness results and verified access still precede kickoff.

evidence.quote: At entry to the Finance branch, check whether this service order already has credit terms approved by Finance. If approved credit terms exist, record financial clearance without issuing or waiting for a deposit invoice. Otherwise issue the deposit invoice, wait for the deposit to arrive, then record financial clearance. Being a repeat client is not sufficient by itself; a repeat client without approved credit terms follows the deposit path.

Its statement that every client must pay a deposit before scheduling describes the earlier new-client-only policy, not today's complete rule. The current practice is the approved-credit-terms exception above. A tentative calendar hold is allowed during preparing the plan, but the confirmed kickoff is held only after both readiness branches and verified access.

steps.text: A signed order starts intake. The coordinator requests and rechecks missing items until the handover pack is complete.

Finance and Delivery start in parallel. Finance checks approved credit terms: approved terms skip the deposit; all other orders wait for payment. Both routes record clearance. Delivery revises and resends requested changes until the client explicitly approves. Setup waits for both branches.
The engineer creates the workspace and tests access for all named users. Any failure triggers correction and a full retest. Only verified access permits Delivery to confirm and hold the kickoff.
After kickoff the coordinator sends the internal handover pack. Client Success must accept it before the coordinator closes the onboarding record. That closure completes the successful case.

An unpaid deposit gets one reminder after seven calendar days; payment waiting and plan work continue. Fourteen calendar days after readiness starts, or on a withdrawal during readiness, cancel both branches. Refund a received deposit, release any hold and record cancellation.
